reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value at line 44 is http://<user-hostname>, derived directly from param=request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). Although isNonPublicAddress(resolveHost(host)) guards against obvious local addresses, the separate DNS resolution (line 39) and outbound fetch (line 44) pattern allows SSRF to external/internal hosts that pass the basic check. The sink expression new java.net.URL("http://" + host).openConnection().connect() receives attacker-controlled host input on the executed path.

evidence.note: User input param assigned to host variable
SSRF sink: URL constructed with host and opened connection
